# Hyperliquid CLI

> Production-grade CLI and AI Agent framework for Hyperliquid DEX spot and perpetuals trading, order execution, market data, and vault management.

## Overview
- **Documentation**: https://github.com/hypurr-inc/hyperliquid-cli#readme
- **Repository**: https://github.com/hypurr-inc/hyperliquid-cli
- **Agent Skill & Plugin**: Follows Agent Plugins v1.0.0 and Agent Skills standard.
- **Languages**: English (README.md), 繁體中文 (README.zh-TW.md), 简体中文 (README.zh-CN.md), 日本語 (README.ja-JP.md), 한국어 (README.ko-KR.md).

## Quick Installation
- Binary install: `curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hypurr-inc/hyperliquid-cli/main/install.sh && sh install.sh`
- Agent install (skills.sh / Claude / Cursor / Windsurf / TRAE): `npx skills add hypurr-inc/hyperliquid-cli`
- ClawHub (OpenClaw / NanoClaw): `clawhub install wtfsayo/hyperliquid-cli`
- Hermes Agent: `hermes skills install hypurr-inc/hyperliquid-cli`

## Key Capabilities
- **Perpetuals & Spot Trading**: Limit, market, trigger (stop loss, take profit), bracket orders, TWAP with randomization (`--randomize`), and trailing stops.
- **Agent Safety**: Mandatory `--dry-run` inspection, non-interactive JSON responses, schema discovery (`hyperliquid schema --json`), withdrawal-proof agent API wallets.
- **HIP-3 DEXes & Staking**: Full support for HIP-3 DEX markets, validator staking, and vault deposits/withdrawals.

## Structured Interfaces for Agents
- Canonical Agent Skill: `skills/hyperliquid-cli/SKILL.md`
- Open Agent Plugin manifest: `plugin.json`
- Claude Code Plugin: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
